caption: The drawing shows a wooden chest of drawers with a built-in writing desk. The chest is composed of six drawers, four smaller ones in the top section and two larger ones at the bottom. The second drawer from the top is shown open and is designed as a drop-front writing desk; its front panel folds down to create a flat writing surface supported by two green, curved metal arms attached to both sides. Inside the open writing desk are six smaller compartments divided by vertical yellow wooden sections. Each of the external drawers is fitted with two round brass knobs. The wood appears to be a medium brown color with visible grain, and the chest stands on four short legs. The background is a plain off-white color, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Secretary
